results.title: Movers & Shakers: Chili’s, Home Agency, Jinx and more | Campaign US
results.content:
EightState Studios appointed Elisa Richardson as chief communications officer and Chip Singh as ECD.

Ernesta hired Rohit Bagalkot as VP of marketing and Kelly Shah as director of inventory planning.

GetResponse welcomed Michael Leslie as chief technology officer.

George P. Johnson (GPJ) promoted Brian Neville to global COO and Paolo Zeppa to president of GPJ Americas.

Goliath promoted Angela Truhan to VP of global brand marketing and named Liz Grampp VP of North American marketing. [...] Pennant appointed D’Marco Saunders as growth and marketing manager.

PMG hired Jon Lefferts as head of video and audio.

Rethink welcomed Caroline Grayson as MD, New York.

RingoFire named Scott Voege EVP of client success.

SixTwentySix added Jimmy Tatro to its roster of directors.

Super Nice appointed Tiffany Lynch Kimicata as MD and Raqib Sheikh as chief strategy officer.

The Social Lights hired Dave Bullen as VP of creative. [...] Trilliad welcomed Jolene Chan as president of data and technology services.

VSA Partners named May Shek associate partner and head of strategy.

Vurvey Labs appointed Dustin Williams as field chief technology officer.
